title: Synergetic mono- and bimetallic tungstate–biochar composites for efficient adsorptive removal of aniline blue from simulated wastewater: reusability, multivariate analysis, and greenness assessment
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28452-28481
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02562E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kizhan S. Rostam, Khanda F. M. Amin
Enhanced adsorption of aniline blue is achieved using metal tungstate–biochar composites, with performance governed by surface properties and following ZW/LB > ZMW/LB > MW/LB in simulated wastewater.
